description: Panel-break triggers (Tier-3 #1). Walks the drivers at panel.cpp:1079 deliberately: five-plus balloons accumulating in one panel, the same speaker sending twice in a row (speaker-already-present), an explicit <Brk>, and an ACTION message. panelsWide is 3 rather than the 2 every other case uses, so per-row fitting and the interstice math get exercised too.

messages.text: six pushes past the five-balloon limit
seven from a speaker already in the panel
eight from that same speaker again
